articles.title: US Proposes Stricter J 1 Visa Rules That Could Affect Indian Researchers, Doctors And Professors
articles.description: The US State Department has proposed significant reforms to the J 1 Exchange Visitor Program, impacting numerous Indian professionals, including researchers and educators. New regulations include stricter compliance measures, grounds for terminating J 1 status, and tighter deadlines for program extensions. Participants may face fixed admission periods and must apply for extensions well in advance. Additionally, record management within the Student and Exchange Visitor Information System (SEVIS) will be streamlined. The proposed changes aim to enhance program integrity and oversight, with a public comment period of 60 days.

articles.title: Quote of the Day by Cary Grant: “It’s better to buy one good pair of shoes than... – Inspiring lessons on money, investment, choices, shopping and why quality over quantity matters by the American actor known for his and timeless wisdom and deep insights on human nature and life
articles.description: Quote of the Day by Cary Grant: Cary Grant’s quote, “It’s better to buy one good pair of shoes than four cheap ones,” explores the importance of quality, thoughtful choices, and long-term value in life. The quote suggests that investing in something durable and meaningful is often more rewarding than choosing multiple cheaper options that may not last. It highlights the value of patience, wise decision-making, and appreciating quality over quantity. Cary Grant’s words remind us that true satisfaction often comes from choosing things that offer reliability, purpose, and lasting benefits rather than focusing only on immediate savings or temporary advantages.

articles.title: Archaeologists discovered Spain's oldest known Roman library inside a villa in Córdoba
articles.description: Archaeologists identified a room at Fuente Álamo as the oldest Roman library. This space was previously thought to be a shrine to the god Mithras. The library's architecture matches known Roman library designs and is the westernmost in the empire. Its discovery highlights the cultural ambitions of its wealthy owner. This finding offers a unique glimpse into Roman intellectual life in Baetica.

articles.title: Explosions Rock Erbil; Iran's Lethal Kamikaze Drone Strike On Kurdish Groups Spark Massive Fire
articles.description: A massive explosion has rocked Erbil, the capital of Iraq's Kurdistan Region, after what reports describe as a kamikaze drone strike. Dramatic videos circulating online appear to show a huge fireball lighting up the night sky as anti-aircraft guns attempt to intercept the incoming drone. RT reported that the drone struck the headquarters of a Kurdish opposition group, while some reports claimed Iran was behind the attack. The latest strike comes amid escalating tensions in northern Iraq, following recent drone attacks near the US Consulate and growing warnings from Tehran to Kurdish leaders. As regional tensions intensify, fears of a wider Middle East conflict continue to mount.
